decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete hero_imagery requirement and records the restored hero layout and non-overlap constraint; no additional change is required.
Allowing the book cover anywhere on the landing page changes its visual placement, not the hero title, copy, CTA, or selling-point emphasis.
The book-cover placement and sizing decision does not change the mechanics or prize-section messaging.
The source decision concerns the landing-page book cover and does not alter any FAQ content.
Changing the book cover's landing-page placement and size does not affect dashboard commission or prize-ticket displays.
The source decision does not change prize payout, announcement, or notification behavior.
Book-cover presentation is independent of the commission and prize-ticket rewards for coded referrals.
The landing-page cover placement does not change the PDF.js reader, read-only default, reader entry points, or offline download behavior.
The source decision does not concern the optional tipping control on the minting page.
Moving or resizing the ebook cover does not alter the NFT mint number's use or display as a referral code.
The cover-display decision does not affect the deferred Transak fiat on-ramp, its payment methods, or its buyer requirements.
